verdict.rationale: Graphite ships built-in AI assistants that accept delegated tasks. Its Agents take plain-language requests, pull repository context, generate changes, and open draft PRs or commit directly to the branch from the PR page. Graphite Chat can summarize PRs, suggest and apply fixes in one click, and diagnose failing CI checks, while Graphite Agent automatically reviews PRs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent's delegated task execution works well in practice.
